name: 紫夜星轨
direction: Quiet violet night: a refined deep-indigo and plum productivity interface with pale lavender actions and cool ice-blue secondary details. Dark purple rather than black. 18–22 logical px corners, restrained layered cards, exceptionally legible off-white Chinese type, soft clear borders. Signature: a faint orbital line in the top header and short connection arcs in device cards, suggesting a distributed mesh. No acid green, no cyberpunk, no RGB gamer neon, no bright glow cloud and no noisy star field.
